mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND STATUS = 'A'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", EMAIL AS "memberEmail", NICKNAME AS "memberNickname", NAME AS "memberName", PROFILE_IMAGE AS "memberProfileImg", MEMBER_TYPE AS "memberRole", STATUS AS "memberStatus", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt" FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE 1=1
AND NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND (NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_BOARD C
JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE C.STATUS != 'N'
AND (C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R
JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE R.STATUS != 'N'
AND (R.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION WHERE 1=1
AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR REGION LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
